newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices - Nov 26.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices - Nov 26.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

-------- COMMENTS - Bunker prices plunged late Tuesday as cargo prices fell in line with crude, traders said. Bunker 380-cst offers started at $124-$125 but eased to $120-$121 late Tuesday. Volumes were healthy as shipowners emerged to buy their requirements when prices dipped. A major said he sold a 2,000 tonne parcel of 380-cst at $120 per tonne late Tuesday.
